data.description:
## Goal

`npm run monte-carlo` fails with `ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION` for `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv`: tsx's loader misparses the Vite `?raw` query suffix for non-TS/TXT extensions (erroneously treating the CSV as a JS module). Pre-existing — reproduced identically at commit b2bec26b (before CG-0MT3J8FXG006RCOA F1-F4 work) and at HEAD. Discovered while verifying CG-0MT47FBLS000E7PW (Monte Carlo sanity check).

## Working path confirmed

`node_modules/.bin/vite-node scripts/monte-carlo.ts --seeds 200 --seed-prefix mc-balance --maxTurns 25 --strategy greedy --out <json> --csv-out <csv>` runs the harness correctly (200/200 runs; winRate 38.5%, medianScore 55.8, avgNoActionTurns 0). The tsx invocation is the only broken link.

## Likely fix options (to evaluate)

- Switch package.json monte-carlo/monte-carlo-sweep scripts from `tsx` to `vite-node` (used by sibling generators, e.g. card-catalog.md line 67) — requires doc updates (docs/DEVELOPER.md, AGENTS.md scripts list) per the Doc-Update Policy.
- Or add a loader hook for ?raw queries to the tsx invocation.
